before-field-243.definition: Exact archived review before the return to original Alberta, Montana and Vancouver Island field logs. This isolates the added field records from the earlier facies reclassification.

alternate-field-bounds.definition: Use 14 cm from Kilpoola core 1 at the common location, the 108 cm main Johnson package alone, retain only Foy core A, and widen the three Greater Victoria host ceilings to the part of physical core left after subtracting the sampled early and late sections.

prior-244.definition: Exact archived 244-position input. Regional settings come from the revised geographic selection; compare all families on their stated domains.

omit-reinterpreted-ceilings.definition: Omit every new or changed ceiling in the deposit-nature review. This removes the complete-local-retention assumption for those packages.

half-capture-ceilings.definition: Double each new or revised package ceiling as a sensitivity to a retained thickness fraction of 0.5. The factor is a stress assumption.

omit-all-archive-ceilings.definition: Remove all conditional upper limits, including the earlier cryptotephra and enclosing-section upper envelopes.

omit-qualified-identities.definition: Drop low-confidence sources including the one-shard On-off Lake correlation, probable Stowell ash, distal ice/cryptotephra assignments and distorted Hasse horizon.

jenny-one.definition: Retain the directly registered JEN13-2E photo as the sole Jenny Lake likelihood.

jenny-omit.definition: Omit all five Jenny Lake stations, including their conditional enclosing-section bounds.

cathedral-one.definition: Use only the Lake of the Woods A12 central core among the four adjacent Cathedral basins. This tests closely correlated archive behavior and shared source attribution.

yellowstone-one.definition: Retain central core YL16-5A as the single Yellowstone Lake likelihood. All core positions remain in the evidence inventory.

restore-williams.definition: Restore the former 46 cm Williams Lake Fen point alone. The unresolved two-horizon interpretation is a historical stress case.

restore-thick-archive-readings.definition: Restore the earlier readings at Windy, Thunder, Round WA, Tumalo, Round OR, Sunrise, Shadow, Dog OR and White Pine Marsh as a joint historical archive-transfer scenario.

omit-basin-beds.definition: Remove selected measured lake beds and conditional upper limits from the Ruby Mountains, Lyman, Roe, Great Salt Lake, Rainier and Yellowstone. This tests shared limnological preservation.

omit-young-proximal.definition: Omit Young’s individually mapped upper pumice minima as a group to test leverage of spatially clustered partial-component constraints.
